info.name: Arthur GenAI Engine Agent Discovery Inferences API

params.name: start_time
params.description: Inclusive start date in ISO8601 string format.

params.name: end_time
params.description: Exclusive end date in ISO8601 string format.

params.name: rule_types
params.description: List of RuleType to query for. Any inference that ran any rule in the list will be returned. Defaults to all statuses. If used in conjunction with with rule_statuses, will return inferences with rules in the intersection of rule_types and rule_statuses.

params.name: rule_statuses
params.description: List of RuleResultEnum to query for. Any inference with any rule status in the list will be returned. Defaults to all statuses. If used in conjunction with with rule_types, will return inferences with rules in the intersection of rule_statuses and rule_types.

params.name: prompt_statuses
params.description: List of RuleResultEnum to query for at inference prompt stage level. Must be 'Pass' / 'Fail'. Defaults to both.

params.name: response_statuses
params.description: List of RuleResultEnum to query for at inference response stage level. Must be 'Pass' / 'Fail'. Defaults to both. Inferences missing responses will not be affected by this filter.

params.name: include_count
params.description: Whether to include the total count of matching inferences. Set to False to improve query performance for large datasets. Count will be returned as -1 if set to False.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Page size. Default is 10. Must be greater than 0 and less than 5000.

items.docs: Paginated inference querying. See parameters for available filters. Includes inferences from archived tasks and rules.
